description: A Dart class 'StorageService' providing local persistence using SharedPreferences for saving and loading a list of recipe IDs.

classes.name: StorageService
classes.description: Provides methods to save and load a list of saved recipe IDs using local storage.

methods.name: loadSaved
methods.description: Loads the list of saved recipe IDs from local storage asynchronously.

methods.name: saveList
methods.description: Saves the provided list of recipe IDs to local storage asynchronously.
